title: [FEATURE] Add a simple slash command to display the CURRENT working folder
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet
- [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features)

### Problem Statement

Claude sometimes can get confused as to the directory that it is currently in and you have to ask it to check this.

### Proposed Solution

Add a simple slash command to display the CURRENT working folder that CLAUDE has moved itself to. Sometimes it is not where it thinks it is and this would be a FAST way to know which full path DIR it is located in.

Simply add `/pwd` to have Claude reorient itself regarding it's working directory.

### Alternative Solutions

_No response_

### Priority

Low - Nice to have

### Feature Category

File operations

### Use Case Example

Claude tries to perform a command. It fails repeatedly because it doesn't realize that it's in the wrong directory.

### Additional Context

_No response_
